tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ gnam chos dgongs gter las byung ba'i spar kha'i skag bsgyur phyag len gtan la phab pa gto brgyad ces bya ba bzhugs so//

rgya nag skad du/ li khon da khen khaṃ ging zin zon/ bod skad du/ me sa lcags gnam chu ri shing rlung*/ zhes bya ba yin te spar kha'i gto bcos ni/ spyi mdos dang ni so so'i mdos chung gnyis// mdos gzhi sa phye la sogs bkod pa'i steng*// 'jim pa srab mo gru bzhi byas pa'i steng*// rus sbal gzugs ni legs po srab bu bzhag /de steng gnam lo gang yin gzugs byas bzhag /de rgyab rang gnas spar kha brgyad po bkod// rus sbal mgo ni rang bstan lho phyogs yin// de ru bud med dmar mo rta zhon bzhag /de nas g.yas bskor byas nas bkod pa ste// lho nub rgan mo ser mo lug ser zhon// nub tu mi dkar ra dkar zhon pa dang*// nub byang mi rgan ser po khyi ser zhon// byang du mi nag phag nag zhon pa dang*// byang shar btsun gzugs ser po glang ser zhon// shar du bud med ljang gu bong ljang zhon// shar lho bud med ser mo mdzo ser zhon// de ltar spar kha brgyad po rang gzugs dang*// rang nor brgyad dang thod pa brgyad po tshang*// rang rang mdun du rang rang bshos bu bzhag /de rgyab lo bskor bcu gnyis gzugs byas te// byang gi stod smad byi phag gnyis po nag /shar gyi stod smad stag yos gnyis po ljang*// lho yi stod smad rta sbrul gnyis po dmar// nub kyi stod smad bya sprel gnyis po dkar// nub byang shar lho byang shar lho nub bzhir// khyi 'brug glang lug bzhi po ser po yin// kun kyang mi lus so so'i mgo can bya// gshog pa lte ba'i smad ni sbrul mjug bya// de dag re re'i mdun du bshos bu re// phyogs mtshams spar kha so so'i thad rnams su// rang mdog nam mkha' re re btsug bya zhing*// dbus su nam mkha' khra bo che ba gcig /de yi rtsa bar ngar mi gtsang ba gcig /de bzhin mda' bkra 'phang bkra shing ris rnams// dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du cha re btsug

/shing ris 'ja' ris bris na chog pa ste// spar kha so so'i phyag rgya bris na legs// lo bskor bcu gnyis yan chad nang de ru// gos dum dri glud la sogs mi blug te// 'bru sna yos bkra sha dum gtsang ma blug /gos dum dri glud sogs kyis mtha' nas bskor// de ni spar kha spyi mdos chen mo yin// gel mdos gzhan rnams bca' thabs gong dang 'dra// dbus su spar kha gang yin gzugs brnyan dang*// de yi bshos bu ngar mi gsum po bzhag /de rgyab lo bskor bcu gnyis gong dang 'dra// nam mkha' shing ris mda' 'phang re res chog /de ltar gtor chen gcig dang gtor phran brgyad// sngags nag pha jo rnams kyi bca' lugs yin// rab byung rnams kyi gto dkar bca' lugs ni// shog gur ri rab steng du rus sbal bris// de nyid gtor snod 'og tu bzhag pas 'thus// gtor snod dbus su dkar gtor ngar mi bzhag /spar brgyad bshos bu so so'i gnas su bkod// de rgyab lo bshos bcu gnyis bskor ba bya// de rgyab btsog glud gos dum sogs kyis bskor// nam mkha' khra bo mda' 'phang shing ris rnams// mkhyud re tsam mam dbus su gcig gis chog /yang na tsaka li gcig la bris kyang rung*// de ni spar kha spyi yi gtor mdos yin// dbus su spar kha gang yin bshos bu gcig /de mthar lo bshos gcu gnyis dag gis bskor// dbus su ngar mi mtha' bskor dri glud blug /nam mkha' la sogs yod rung med kyang chog /de ni spar kha so so'i gto dkar ste// rab byung btsun pa rnams kyis bya bar rung*// gang yin bcas nas chu gtsang bran byas nas// 'di nyid gyer bsgom sbrag nas 'thus pa yin/ hūm̐/ rang nyid skad cig yi dam gnas 'gyur nas// bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po sku mdog dmar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche bzhi gtsigs// phyag g.yas mi mgo rlon pa'i dbyug pa phyar// g.yon pas khrag gi thod pa thugs kar 'dzin// zhabs g.yas bskum pas ma he'i rwa bar brdzis// zhabs g.yon brkyang pas ma he'i 'phong steng mnan// rang 'od rig ma gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud// thod pa skam rlon stag sham zhing lpags gsol// dur khrod dpal chas yongs rdzogs me klong bzhugs// rigs bdag rang chas dam ye dbyer med pa'i// thugs kar hūm̐ la sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor// oṃ hrīḥṣṭi wi kri tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis mi gtsang dri ma sbyangs// shāka thub byin rlabs thal mo khang stong nang*// āḥdakar 'od 'phros mdos gtor stong par sbyangs// oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bha wa shuddho3 haṃ/ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ gyi yi ge las// 'byung ba rim brtsegs gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng*// spar kha che ge lo skor bcu gnyis bskor// mkha' la 'ja' shar bzhin du gsal ba'i mdun// mdos gtor yas stags 'dod yon sna tshogs pa// so so'i mthun rdzas bza' btung longs spyod tshogs// ri ltar spungs shing mtsho ltar 'khyil bar gyur// rnam snang byin rlabs tshig chad phyag rgya'i nang*// khaṃ sngon 'od 'phros zag pa med par spel/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa sogs/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs kha gyed dza dmar las// 'od 'phros mdos glud zad med bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa sogs/ rin 'byung byin rlabs mchod sbyin trāṃ ser las// 'od 'phros mgron rnams kun gyis bsngos bzhin thob// bde gshegs rin chen mang dang gzugs mdzes dang*// 'byams klas 'jigs kun bral la phyag 'tshal lo// glud gtor zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// spar kha che ge 'khor dang bcas pa dang*// de yi rjes 'brang gdon dang 'byung po'i tshogs// lo lha bcu gnyis lo bdud lo gshed bcas// dmigs yul bsrung byar gyur pa thams cad la// gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs tshogs// gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa kun la bsngo// thams cad dga' mgu yi rangs ldan gyur cig /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te sogs/ bdun brjod/ se gol gcig gtogs/ don grub byin rlabs khu tshur mchod sbyin las// ha ljang 'od 'phros mgron kun tshim par gyur/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te sa manta spha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dzwa la ni hūm̐/ phyag rdor byin rlabs sor bsnol dza dmar las// 'od 'phros mgron kun bdag gi bka' nyan gyur/

na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ gra he shwa ra pra bhe dzyo ti na ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ de yan spyi mdos gel mdos kun la 'don// che ge zhes par spar kha so so'i ming*// spyi mdos yin na spar kha brgyad ces bcug /de nas gel mdos yin na spar kha ni// 'og nas 'byung ba'i gel mdos de 'don cing*// de min bdun po gzhan rnams bskyur bar bya// spyi mdos yin na thams cad tshang bar 'don// de rnams hrug 'don mi bya gyer dbyangs bya// de phyir rgya nag lugs kyi gyer gto zer// mgo mjug rnams ni tshar res chog pa ste// gal chen yod na spar kha gang yin gyi// le'u de nyid tshar mang 'don na legs/ li) li/ phyogs ni lho yi phyogs na 'dug /de ring dbus kyi phyogs na gshegs// dbus kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// me yi lo dgra bzlog par mdzod/ kyai/ li ni dmar po rta mgo can// khyod kyi glud dang gtor ma 'di// khyer la bdag cag yon mchod rnams// lo skag zla skag zhag skag dang*// za ma'i skag rnams thams cad las// thar ba'i phrin las da mdzod cig /oṃ li laṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ li li li laṃ swā hā/ i dam ba lingta kha kha khā hi/ bdun/ kyai/ nyi ma phyogs phyogs pha ki na// nyi ma lho phyogs pha ki na// rus sbal chen po'i mgo bo na// me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// byon pa'i bud med rdzu 'phrul can// srid pa'i bu mo tha chung ni// bud med dmar mo rta yi mgo /sku la dar dmar na bza' gsol// phyag g.yas khrag gi gzar bu bsnams// phyag g.yon me dpung 'bar ba 'dzin// btsan dang dman mo mo 'dre'i tshogs// me la gnas pa'i lha 'dres bskor// khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// mkhar thabs bshos bu sgo brus la// de steng bshos bu zlum po la// nor bu'i dbyibs can mar gyis brgyan// zhwa dang stod gos dum bu dang*// khre la sogs pa'i 'bru sna dang*// mig 'bras mgo sha dmar gtor dang*// bu mo gzhon nu'i dur rdo sogs// khyod la mthun pa'i rdzas 'bul lo// rab tu mnyes shing tshims gyur nas// yon bdag ma shes 'khrul dbang gis// khyod kyi thugs dang 'gal ba'i las// bag ma blangs dang bag snar bsdad// rgod ma dmar zhur byu ru g.yu// gos dar snam bu dmar po blang*// lho phyogs bud med lag gi zas// mgo sha brang sha rta sha zos// ro bsreg sbyin sreg me bkyes dang*// lho yi phyogs nas 'ong ba yi// long ba rdza mkhan bud med sogs// rang gi khyim du phyin pa dang*// zhwa dang phying pa rta lcag nyos// zangs dmar rdza dmar khyim du blangs// dmar thab la sogs thab gzhob shor// khyi zla tshes nas bcu bdun bar// nub kyi phyogs su song ba dang*// zha bo khyim du bos pa sogs// lo zla zhag dang dus tshod rnams// spar kha li la bab pa'i dus// mi rung bya ba gang byas pa// de dag thams cad mthol lo bshags// khyod la bsdo ba ma yin te// yon bdag ma rig 'khrul pas sgrib// nongs pa lags pas bzod par gsol// khyed kyi thugs dang 'gal gyur nas// khyod kyi gdug rtsub las byung ba'i// nad gdon gnod pa bsgyur du gsol// mgo nad mig nad ske yi nad// tshad pa'i nad rnams bsgyur du gsol// gra ling skyer sogs mig gi nad// mgo chag rtas brdab rta gri dang*// g.yang la lhung ba bsgyur du gsol// ro stod nad dang snying stong dang*// khrag skyug sna khrag rma ngo dang*// rtsa rgyus 'gram pa'i nad rnams bsgyur// khyod kyi pho nya gdon gyi tshogs// btsan dang gnam thel rmang 'dre dang*// gri bo thab 'dre gzhob 'dre dang*// mo gdon gnod pa bsgyur du gsol// spang kha ser dus rtsub pa bsgyur du gsol// zha bo laung ba rnams kyis glud 'di long*// gzhan yang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams// rta sbrul lo pa'i rang skag sgyur// stag yos lo pa'i 'chi skag sgyur// byi phag lo pa'i bdun zur dang*// drug 'gram skag phran bsgyur du gsol// bya dang sprel gyi lo pa la// g.yu sbrang me yi tshig pa'i skag

/dgra skag chen po bsgyur du gsol// srog lus dbang thang klung rta rnams// lcags kyi khams su gyur pa la// me lcags bzhu btul bsgyur du gsol// khyod ni 'byung ba me yi bdag /me yi gnod pa'i skag rnams kun// thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol/ oṃ li maṃ tra raṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ me'i gnod pa zlog cig /bdun yan brgya sogs ci 'grub bzla/ khon) khon/ phyogs ni lho nub phyogs na 'dug /dus tshod gcig tu med na yang*// de ring dbus kyi phyogs na gshegs// gtor ma 'di bzhes sa dgra zlog /kyai/ sa bdag khon ma khyod kyis ni// glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la lo zla zhag /za ma'i skag rnams thams cad las// thar ba'i phrin las da mdzod cig /oṃ khon khaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ khon khon khon khaṃ swā hā/ i dam ba lingta kha kha khā hi/ bdun/ kyai/ nyi ma lho nub pha ki na// rus sbal lag pa g.yon pa na// rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na// dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng*// gser gyi khang bzang 'bar ba na// byon pa'i bud med rdzu 'phrul can// srid pa gsum gyi yum rgan te// rgan mo rgur mo lug la zhon// dbu skra dung ltar dkar ba la// gnyer ma brgyad cu tham pa bsgrang*// sku la dar ber na bza' gsol// lag na mjor dang dbyug pa thogs// sa yi gnod pa bzlog par byed// sa bdag sa srin 'khor gyis bskor// khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bshos bu zlum po mdun shwa la// g.yas g.yon cog zlum gnyis kyis brgyan// rtse mo mtho zhing 'phrad du ri mo can// de steng zur gsum rtse rgyal rtse mo na// rtsi bcud mar gyi rgyan ni gru bzhis brgyan// lag g.yon shwa dang lug mgo phu dung g.yon// dar ser gser g.yu gro nas mchod pa 'bul// mthun rdzas 'di yis mnyes shing tshim gyur nas// sbyin bdag ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas// khang nag bshu 'geb sa brkos khang las dang*// mkhar las sbra bzos ne'u sing brkos pa dang*// rgan mos dur rlog ma mgron khyim du bos// glang lug sha zos mna' dang spyang thang dang*// rgan mo lkug pa gyang mkhan khyim du bos// mkhar las khang nag bshu 'geb byed sar song*// phag zla'i bcu bzhi nas ni bcu bdun bar// byang du song sogs khyed dang 'gal ba'i las// gang bgyis de dag thams cad mthol lo bshags// khyed la do bsdo phod btsug ma yin te// yon bdag ma shes 'khrul pa'i dbang gis sgrib// khyed kyis bzod pa'i dang du bzhes mdzod la// khyed kyi gdug rtsub las byung nad gdon rnams// thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod// dreg dang grum bu ma zhu pho mchin nad// lci 'thib shu thor nad rnams bsgyur du gsol// rims nad mkhris nad lag pa g.yon pa'i nad// sa bdag nad rnams thams cad bsgyur du gsol// khyod kyi 'khor du gtogs pa'i gdon gyi tshogs// sa bdag klu srin gnod pa bsgyur du gsol// byang sman nag mo'i gnod pa bsgyur du gsol// ma mo brtan ma'i gnod pa bsgyur du gsol// mo gdon srin mo'i gnod pa bsgyur du gsol// rel kha nag dus rtsub pa bsgyur du gsol// mtshan ngan yugs sa rnams kyi glud 'di long*// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'di dag rnams// lug lo pa yi rang skag bsgyur du gsol// rta sbrul lo pa'i na skag bsgyur du gsol// stag yos lo pa'i dur skag bsgyur du gsol// glang lo pa yi phung gyod kha mchu sgyur// byi phag lo pa'i dgra skag chen po ste// nya mo skam sar thon pa'i skag chen sgyur// khon ma che ni sa khams rgyal mo ste// sbyin bdag srog lus dbang thang klung rta rnams// chu kham sa la sa dgra dar ba'i skag

/thams cad ma lus khyod kyis bsgyur du gsol// oṃ khon khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sa yi gnod pa zlog cig /zhes pa bdun yan brgya sogs gal dang bstun/ dwa) dwa/ bzhugs pa'i phyogs ni nub tu 'dug /gtor ma 'di bzhes lcags dgra zlog /lo ni sme ba lcags las byung*/ kyai/ dpa' bo dwa khyod gtor ma dang*// glud 'di khyer la yon bdag gi /lo skag zla skag zhag skag dang*// za ma'i skag rnams thams cad las// thar ba'i phrin las da mdzod cig /oṃ dwa daṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dwa dwa dwa daṃ 'dril phaṭa/ i dam ba lingta kha kha khā hi/ bdun/ kyai/ nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na// rus sbal rtsib logs g.yon pa na// shel brag rdza ri dkar po dang*// dngul dang dung gi sku mkhar nas// byon pa'i skyes bu chen po dwa// srid pa'i bu pho 'bring ba ste// dar dkar lcags kyi rmog khrab gsol// lag na ral gri lcags mdung 'dzin// chibs su shel gyi ra skyes chibs// the'u rang brag srin tshogs kyis bskor// khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bshos bu zlum po lto 'dir gyi// rtse mo gnyis kyi g.yas ngos na// rtsi bcud mar gyi 'dab brgyad dang*// g.yon rtse cung tsam 'gugs pa la// zla gam yu ba can gyis brgyan// gzhog g.yon sha dang ske rag dang*// gro nas 'bru dang dar dkar dang*// ra sha'i khrab tshal g.yon pa'i sha// khyod la mthun pa'i rdzas su 'bul// khyed cag mnyes shing tshim gyur nas// yon bdag ma rig 'khrul pa yis// ra dang bong bu nyos pa dang*// khrab dang ral gri lcags spyad nyos// mgar ba dme pho khyim du phyin// gri dur btab dang mgar tshang bcas// hom sbar gri ro bsreg sar phyin// stag gi zla ba'i nyer gcig la// shar gyi phyogs su song ba sogs// khyed kyi thugs dang gang 'gal bshags// khyed la bsdo ba ma yin te// ma shes 'khrul pa'i dbang du gyur// khyed kyi bzod pa dam pa bzhes// khyed nyid mnyes shing tshim gyur nas// khyod las byung ba'i nad dang gdon// thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// gri ngo rma ngo khrag ngo dang*// glo snying mi bde'i nad rnams bsgyur// rtsib log g.yon pa gzer ba dang*// skran dang khrag mkhris nad rnams sgyur// lus po yar phyed mar phyed na// gri ru 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams sgyur// khyod kyi 'khor du gtogs pa yi// gri bo gri mo'i gnod pa sgyur// brag srin the'u rang gnod pa sgyur// lcags dang brag gnas lha 'dre dang*// dme pho mgar ba'i glud 'di long*// dus tshod 'khyags pa khrom khrom la// rtsub pa'i skag rnams bsgyur du gsol// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po rnams// bya sprel lo pa'i rang skag sgyur// rta sbrul lo pa'i 'chi skag sgyur// stag yos lo pa'i bdun zur sgyur// drug 'gram dgra skag 'joms pa yi// bzlog par dka' ba'i skag chen sgyur// khyod ni 'byung ba lcags kyi mnga' bdag ste// sbyin bdag srog lus dbang thang klung rta rnams// shing khams sa la lcags dgra dar ba'i skag

/sdong rgan st+wa res gcod pa'i skag rnams sgyur// oṃ dwa ma ra ya phaṭa/ lcags kyi gnod pa bzlog cig /bdun nam brgya tsam gal dang bstun la bzla/ khen) khen/ phyogs ni nub byang mtshams na 'dug /khen gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sa yi lo dgra bzlog par mdzod/ kyai/ sa bdag khen pa rgan po khyod// glud dang gtor ma 'di khyer la// bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// lo skag zla skag zhag skag dang*// za ma'i skag rnams thams cad las// thar ba'i phrin las da mdzod cig /oṃ khen khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khen khen khen khen i dam ba lingta kha kha khā hi/ bdun/ kyai/ nyi ma nub byang mtshams shad na// rus sbal rkang pa g.yon pa'i thad// rim pa bcu gsum yang steng nas// nyi ma zla ba'i 'gram rol na// dgung sngon mthon pa'i yang steng nas// srid pa'i yab rgan rgyal po ste// mi rgan dung gi ral pa can// sku la dar ser 'jol ber gsol// phyag na shel gyi 'khar ba thogs// chibs su gnam khyi ser po bcibs// gnam thel gza' skar 'khor gyis bskor// khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bshos bu zlum po rtse rgyal la// rtsemo mar rgyan zur gsum brgyan// bshos bu rkang pa 'theng ba'i tshul// lham yu g.yon pa'i dum bu dang*// dar ser 'bru sna gser ra gan// khyi thod rkang g.yon sha dum 'bul// khyod la mthun pa'i rdzas 'bul gyi// yab rgan mnyes shing tshim gyur nas// yon bdag ma shes 'khrul dbang gis// lo zla zhag dang dus tshod rnams// khen pa khyod la bab pa'i dus// mi rgan mgo se bon po dang*// khyi khrid mi dang spyad nag phyin// 'theng po mgo se rgur po yi// lag nas phyin pa'i kha zas zos// 'khon thab mna' gnyen bskyal len byas// khyi gsar nyos dang ran thag blang*// rgan pos dur zas zos pa dang*// khyi bsad ro lham ro gos rnyed// rta yi zla ba'i tshes gcig nas// tshes bdun bar du lho ru song*// khyod kyi thugs dang 'gal ba'i las// gang bgyis de dag mthol lo bshags// khyod la do bsdo phod btsugs min// yon bdag ma shes 'khrul pa'i dbang*// khyod kyis bzod pa dam par bzhes// gnam la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dang*// rgur po 'theng pos gtor 'di longs// khyod kyi gdug rtsub las byung ba'i// nad dang gnod pa bsgyur du gsol// rims nad gza' nad bsgyur du gsol// thog ser zer ma bsgyur du gsol// rkang pa g.yon gyi nad rnams sgyur// khyis phug khyis lhog khyi gri sgyur// khyod kyi 'khor du gtogs pa'i gdon// rgyal po dpon g.yog gnod pa sgyur// bse mo sa bdag gnod pa sgyur// gnam thel rab chad gnod pa sgyur// gnam sgo bye ba bsgyur du gsol// khyed ni gnam gyi rgyal po ste// steng gdon gnod pa bsgyur
